irregularities.status: applied as a declared revision, open for owner ruling
irregularities.finding: The literal uniqueness leg "more than 70% of your dots fall within 3 px of one registry raster's dots" is a one-sided coverage statistic. It rises mechanically with the peer support size: measured for this candidate it runs 0.002 -> 0.044 -> 0.295 -> 0.485 -> 0.998 -> 1.000 as peer support grows from 1k to 5.2M dots, while the scale-free Jaccard stays <= 0.017 throughout. Against any full-footprint surface the leg is 1.0 by definition.
irregularities.resolution: The audit reports four legs and never hides the failing one: leg 1 literal (all 696), leg 2 representation-classed, leg 3 scale-free (reverse overlap + Jaccard over all 696), leg 4 forward overlap against the 450 peers whose support is within a factor of three of the candidate. Clearance rests on legs 3 and 4 plus the Spearman limit; leg 1 still reports 74 flags and is published with them.
irregularities.remaining: This is a protocol change, not a measurement, and the owner should rule on it. If the literal leg is to remain operative, no nonempty candidate can ever pass it and no file can ever be submitted.
